https://api.github.com/repos/zita-ch/sup.name: supermimic_vibed_commits.json
https://api.github.com/repos/zita-ch/sup.head: 2a26b2f8c4d616e16361a616fe659c7d4acdf317
https://api.github.com/repos/zita-ch/sup.message:
Adopt acceleration-only world model and strided goal; add trained checkpoint

Changes after comparing with the official release, verified on the 40-clip
LAFAN1 run: return 0.842 with 0/40 failed clips at 0.95 h of training
(iteration 10000), against 0.829 at 1.31 h before.

- World model predicts only acceleration-level increments; positions and the
  root rotation are integrated analytically. Loss uses fixed nominal errors
  per channel group and also supervises root velocities.
- Goal is a strided window of 10 reference frames 5 steps apart (~0.9 s) and
  carries the robot-relative reference orientation per frame; the critic also
  sees the relative root position. Observation is proprioception only.
- LayerNorm + GELU in all networks; critic values clamped to the maximum
  attainable return; optional --optimizer muon (off by default, untested).
- tools/plot.py compares runs and deducts evaluation overhead from the time
  axis. tools/render.py: GPU rendering is opt-in (it hung in the container).
- Add checkpoints/lafan1_g1_it10000.pt, refresh the highlight GIF and the
  success curve, update README and MILESTONES.

Checkpoints from before this commit no longer load (observation and goal
sizes changed).

https://api.github.com/repos/HybridRobot.name: mjlab_research_head.json
https://api.github.com/repos/HybridRobot.head: dd51a9fcc98791a2f0b018b3c7f71a3eefd5ecdd
https://api.github.com/repos/HybridRobot.message:
Load multi-clip motions and compute tracked bodies with forward kinematics

Motion files hold the root link's world pose and twist and the joint states,
with joint names. MotionLoader concatenates per-clip npz files (one path, a
list or a glob) or loads a packed directory written by pack_motions, and
records clip boundaries in motion_ends. MotionCommand computes the tracked
bodies with ForwardKinematics at the current frames, and the motion_end
termination ends an episode at its clip's last frame.

Reset sampling bins are 0.2 s wide and map to frames with exact integer
math. Sampling mode 'external' draws reset frames from a per-bin
distribution set with set_sampling_distribution, adaptive sampling clips
each bin's failure count at adaptive_clip times the mean, and reset frames
never land on a clip's last frame.

csv_to_npz writes the new motion format.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
